name: Table Picker - Open Card
purpose: API Generator dev tool (schema picker). Opens the Table Picker card window on the VIRTUALLIST - Table layout; with no file name it first runs Set VL_File, otherwise it opens the card and immediately calls Table Picker - Handle Click for that file. Effect owner would be client-ui.
calls:
karbon_Generator.fmp12/scripts/377 "Set VL_File" (step 9)
karbon_Generator.fmp12/scripts/391 "Table Picker - Handle Click" (step 16)

name: Table Picker - Handle Click
purpose: API Generator dev tool (schema picker). Handles a click in the picker: on a Table click runs Set VL_Table and moves to the Table object; on a Field click copies the picked file, table and table occurrence names into the GLOBALS.Schema_* fields, runs Set VL_Field and moves to the Field object; otherwise clears the table and returns to the File object. Effect owner would be client-ui.
writes:
GLOBALS::Schema_File#21 (step 16, global)
GLOBALS::Schema_Table#22 (step 17, global)
GLOBALS::Schema_TableOccurence#23 (step 18, global)

name: Table Picker - Save Card
purpose: API Generator dev tool (schema picker). Save button of the picker card: copies the picked field name into GLOBALS::Schema_TableOccurence and closes the card. Effect owner would be client-ui.
open_question: Writes VIRTUALLIST::FieldName into Schema_TableOccurence (a table occurrence field); the target field name looks wrong. Confirm intent.
